name: Klostercafé St. Hildegard
address: Abtei St. Hildegard 1, 65385 Rüdesheim am Rhein, Germany
facts: Bakery uses exclusively Dinkel (spelt) for cakes and bread.
Operated as an inclusion business (gGmbH) since 1 April 2020; team includes staff from Rheingau Werkstätten Rüdesheim.
Picnic baskets available to pre-order, incl. blanket.
All wines from the abbey’s own Weingut.
Kitchen built around Hildegard’s herbs and spices; many ingredients grown on site.
